metadata.description: Publish self-contained HTML artifacts to your own SFTP web host with a stable URL and private-by-default visibility.

plugins.name: artifact-sftp
plugins.description: Publish one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host and get a stable, redeploy-in-place URL that is private (Cloudflare Zero Trust) by default. Includes an interactive setup skill that pins and verifies the SFTP host key.
